meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会接管重构任务：先向你确认意图，再分析代码库和依赖、评估测试覆盖，然后分步骤改代码，每步跑测试和类型检查；覆盖率过低时先让你补测试。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、抽取或现代化某段代码时触发，也可用 /refactor 命令手动调用。

say.text: 帮我重构 src/auth/handler.ts，只改这个文件
say.note: 按 file 范围，先评估再动手

say.text: 把 AuthService 类里的校验逻辑抽取成独立模块
say.note: 默认 module 范围加 safe 策略

say.text: 重构所有用到废弃 API 的函数，用 aggressive 策略
say.note: 仍会要求测试覆盖足够

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs refactors: it confirms intent, maps code and dependencies, checks test coverage, then edits step by step, running tests and type checks each time. With low coverage it asks you to add tests first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor, extract, or modernize code, or when you invoke the /refactor command with a target.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into its own module
Refactor every function using the deprecated API, aggressive strategy
